description: SEC synthetic credit rating — Estimated credit rating for a US-listed non-financial company from SEC 10-K XBRL: interest coverage (operating income / interest expense) mapped to published coverage-to-rating bands (AAA to D), notched down for high net debt / EBITDA, plus total debt, net debt, EBITDA, debt / equity, current ratio, 5-year coverage trend, investment-grade flag and risk flags. Falls back to leverage when interest expense is not tagged. An estimate, not an agency rating. Param ticker (or CIK). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_credit_rating
